title: What does "chosen" mean?
blurb: One situation, two candidate values. Decide which of them has actually been chosen — it may be one, or neither. The definition is exact, and the plausible near-misses are not it.

justification.text: No — no majority voted for Alice within a single ballot. Votes for Alice scattered across different ballots do not add up to a decision; neither does a proposal, a single vote, or a majority that merely holds Alice right now.
